sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Portable Phased-Array Medical Diagnostic Scanners

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (unitary; commercial law governed by the Code de commerce; administrative law governed by the Code des relations entre le public et l'administration)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (currently in force)
France-Hong Kong Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (in force)
France-United States Income Tax Convention (as amended)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: National AML/CFT law is set out in the Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Title VI of Book V, Articles L.561-1 to L.561-50 and R.561-1 to R.561-5; the UBO declaration obligation arises under CMF Article L.561-2-2 and Article L.561-45, read with Code de commerce Article L.123-13-1 and Articles R.123-27 to R.123-32. The framework implements Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/843.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs is not open to the public; access is limited to judicial authorities, TRACFIN, tax authorities, and professional AML/CFT obliged entities conducting customer due diligence)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Charter, certificate of incorporation and full register of shareholders / UBO extract of every corporate shareholder of the French SAS
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent statutory authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for issuances in an apostille-contracting state; French consular legalization for non-Hague issuances

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized/certified copy of passport or other identity document and proof of residential address of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport/civil registry authority or local police authority in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Local notarization, then Hague Apostille or French consular legalization; certified French translation if the original is not in French

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good conduct / judicial record extract for the proposed SAS president and all UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National criminal-record authority or relevant police/justice ministry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, with certified French translation where applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolutions of each corporate shareholder authorizing the incorporation of the SAS, the capital contribution, and the appointment of the president/representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary, notary, or board of directors of the shareholder company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization; certified French translation if the resolution is drafted in another language

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, UBO, director, legal representative, and authorized signatory against: (i) French national PEP and asset-freeze indicators issued by TRACFIN; (ii) EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, including Council Regulations (EU) 269/2014 and 833/2014; (iii) UN Security Council consolidated list; (iv) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Sectoral Sanctions Identifications list; and (v) international PEP, criminal, and adverse-media databases. Any positive hit requires enhanced due diligence, verification of source of funds and wealth, and, where warranted, a written suspicious activity report to TRACFIN under CMF Article L.561-15 within the statutory deadline.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by INPI at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; name availability checks are performed through the INPI national register and the Infogreffe RCS database
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Articles of Association and all documents annexed to the RCS filing must be in French. A corporate name may contain foreign elements, but it must be capable of being written in Latin alphabet characters for the RCS; non-Latin-script names must be phonetically transliterated into Latin characters and accompanied by a certified French translation of the name and the underlying corporate instrument. The name must not be contrary to French public policy or accepted moral standards.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque, Établissement de crédit, Société de financement, Compagnie financière (requires financial regulator authorization from the ACPR)
Assurance, Mutuelle, Prévoyance, Courtier (requires ACPR approval)
Médecin, Pharmacie, Clinique, Laboratoire, Hôpital (requires medical or ARS professional authorization)
Avocat, Notaire, Huissier de justice, Commissaire de justice, Conseil juridique (requires professional order approval)
État, République, Ministère, Préfecture, Mairie (public authority terms are prohibited or restricted)
Organisme notifié, Organisme certificateur, Commissionnaire en douane (requires specific licensing or notified-body status)
SA, SAS, SARL, EURL or other legal-form identifiers may be used only as form descriptors and may not be embedded in a misleading manner within the distinctive part of the corporate name
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not maintain a statutory ex ante name reservation for an SAS; priority is created by the sequence of filing at the RCS. If the proposed name is rejected by the registry, the applicant may file a recours gracieux with the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (or the relevant INPI service) within one month, substantiating distinctiveness and absence of confusion. A further judicial appeal may be brought before the president of the Tribunal de Commerce in non-contentious or summary proceedings; if the rejection is founded on a prior trademark, opposition and invalidity proceedings may be brought before INPI with an appeal before the competent Cour d'appel.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Domiciliation at a licensed domiciliation agent is technically permissible under Article L.123-10 of the Code de commerce, but a purely virtual office without physical file storage or cellular reception of authorities is not accepted as commercial substance for this industry. For an SAS importing or distributing class IIb color Doppler ultrasound consoles, the registered office must be a physical location capable of receiving ANSM and DGCCRF inspections, holding quality-management records, and supporting liaison with the European Authorized Representative.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 15-25% annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by ANSM/DGCCRF for a compliant importer-distributor with a physical registered office; risk increases to 40% during the first 12 months if the registered office is virtual or the company presents itself as a legal manufacturer without corresponding technical and quality-management premises. A fully compliant physical office and technical documentation facility reduces the inspection probability to below 10%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAS pre-incorporation legal engagement: drafting of statuts, corporate authorization resolutions, UBO declaration, notarization liaison, RCS filing preparation and pre-clearance advice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Law firm / notary retained by the founding shareholders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for French business-law firms (EUR 300-500 per hour or fixed fee for SAS formation package)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: French RCS registration formalities at the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce including INPI Guichet unique electronic filing and UBO record filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / INPI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff applicable to company-registry filings in France

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and trademark clearance across INPI, EUIPO, common-law databases and Infogreffe
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI, EUIPO, and independent trademark counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official database search tariff plus fixed professional clearance fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and/or consular legalization of foreign corporate documents, identity documents, board resolutions and criminal-record certificates (estimated 4 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority of the document's country of origin and French Embassy/Consulate for consular legalization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official consular fee per document, estimated average USD 70-90; actual fee may reach USD 120 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translation of foreign corporate records, UBO identity documents and resolution documents (estimated 18 pages)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Court-registered translator market benchmark of EUR 18-25 per page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, sanctions, OFAC, UN, EU and adverse-media screening of UBOs, shareholders and proposed officers, plus UBO register compliance review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent AML/CFT due diligence provider and legal review counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark, fixed annual fee per UBO and per entity

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II: Articles L.210-1, L.210-2, L.210-6, L.210-9, L.227-1 to L.227-20; Code civil; General Tax Code (Code général des impôts) for stamp and registration duties; filing procedure governed by Décret n° 2023-???? and the e-formalities regulations administered by INPI.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) operated by the territorial Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; the incorporation filing is submitted through the INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Formulaire M0 (Immatriculation d'une société commerciale) filed electronically through the INPI 'Guichet Unique' e-portal, together with the executed French-language articles of association and supporting legal dossiers.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum capital for an SAS; share capital must be fully subscribed. Cash contributions are deposited into a blocked bank account opened in the name of the company in formation or consigned with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations. The funds remain blocked until RCS registration and are released only upon production of the certificate of incorporation (K-bis). In-kind contributions require a statutory asset report if not waived by unanimous shareholders and if not material under law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF FR_SAS. Acting unanimously as shareholder and founder, it is resolved: (1) to adopt the French articles of association in their definitive form, being the Société par Actions Simplifiée named FR_SAS; (2) to subscribe fully the stated share capital and to approve the initial President; (3) to fix and adopt the registered office at the address indicated in the articles for all legal and administrative purposes; (4) to authorize the President to open bank accounts, publish the required legal announcement, and file all incorporation documents with the RCS through the INPI Guichet Unique; (5) to ratify the capital deposit and the company-in-formation steps; and (6) to commence activity upon registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name availability review and preparation of French articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI data bank and RCS insolvency registry; legal counsel preparing the statuts; no competent authority approval required at this stage.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name search against the RCS database and INPI trademark register to avoid identical corporate names or trademark conflicts. Draft the French-language articles of association containing corporate name, purpose (manufacture and sale of colour Doppler ultrasound console medical imaging products), registered office address, duration, share capital, share classes, President powers, decision-making procedure, and allocation of profits. Obtain the founder's signature on each page or a formal electronic signature. If real property is contributed, arrange notarization; if cash is contributed, no notarization is mandatory.
required_dossiers: Name availability or trademark search confirmation
Draft executed articles of association in French
Identity documents and passport copies of founder/shareholders
Beneficial owner identification sheet
Power of attorney and proxy copy if founder is not physically present
Residential or professional address proof for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected name is rejected or conflicts, choose a different distinctive name and amend the articles; no substantive penalty is incurred at this pre-filing stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blockage of cash capital and issuance of capital deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank of incorporation; alternatively Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the name of 'FR_SAS, société en formation' and deposit the subscribed cash capital. Instruct the bank to issue an attestation de blocage des fonds / certificate de dépôt de capital, which states the account holder, the amount, and the blocked nature until presentation of the RCS registration extract. If capital is represented by intangible assets or equipment, arrange a report on in-kind contributions by a statutory appraiser if required.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening form
Identity and KYC documents for all shareholders and beneficial owners
Draft articles of association and appointment of temporary representative
Proof of registered office address
Founders' declaration of funds origin if requested by bank compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account due to compliance queries, complete the KYC/AML documentation or transfer the deposit via the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; if the bank declines to block, obtain a notaire's attestation of funds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of the M0 dossier with the INPI Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises; dossier transmitted to the territorial Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and RCS service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the official portal procedures.inpi.fr, select 'Immatriculation d'une société commerciale', complete the M0 answer form, upload all required documents, pay any greffe/tax fees generated by the platform, and submit. The portal issues an immediately-dated receipt. The greffe then verifies compliance with the Code de commerce and company law. If the file is incomplete, the greffe sends a regularisation request; the applicant must remedy within the specified legal period.
required_dossiers: Completed M0 electronic form
Executed articles of association in French
Capital deposit certificate issued by the bank
Proof of legal publication announcement (avis de constitution) or proposed publication document
Proof of registered office: lease, free occupation agreement, or title deed
Declaration of actual beneficiary (Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
Civil liability declaration / no-bankruptcy declaration for the President and directors
Power of attorney if an agent signs the filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe issues a query or incompleteness notice, provide the missing document or corrected PDF through the same INPI procedure; the deadline is suspended. If refused by nature of exclusion, submit the corrected dossier as a new formalité or apply to the Judge supervising the RCS registry within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration, legal announcement, and issuance of K-bis
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; the official legal announcement is published in an approved legal gazette or Journal d'Annonces Légales; the administrative publication of notices is made via the JLonline platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After validation by the greffe, the company is inscribed on the RCS and receives its SIREN, SIRET, and K-bis registration extract. The legal announcement of incorporation must be published in a legal notices gazette within one month of registration. Verify the registration mentions, the registered office, the President's identity, and the NAF code; obtain a certified copy of the K-bis. The K-bis is the official certificate required for bank accounts, tenders, and customs registration.
required_dossiers: Receipt of the INPI Guichet Unique filing
Certificate of RCS registration or provisional K-bis
Copy of the legal announcement and proof of publication in the JAL
Confirmed registered office address document retained by the greffe
Capital release certificate and bank certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If legal announcement publication is delayed, accelerate by choosing an online accredited gazette; if the K-bis indicates an error, file a rectification procedure with the greffe; if registration is refused, challenge by request before the President of the competent tribunal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration corporate governance formalities and statutory books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company secretary or the President of FR_SAS; tax elections declared to the DGFiP Service des Impôts des Entreprises; corporate database update via INPI if beneficial ownership changes.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene a formal decision of the shareholder to ratify the incorporation, confirm the registered office, fix the first accounting year end, and appoint the President and any statutory auditor if required. Create the mandatory statutory registers: register of shares, register of investor decisions, minutes of shareholder decisions, and corporate accounting books. Obtain an EU VAT number by registering with the DGFiP through the online 'Création' process, and open the permanent tax file. Ensure that the company letterhead and registered office sign include the corporate name, SAS legal form, capital amount, RCS number and greffe location.
required_dossiers: Minutes or written decision of the sole shareholder
Register of shares and share transfers
Register of shareholders'/board decisions
Bank account certificate for the registered company
Authorization resolution for the opening of commercial accounts and signatory powers
Tax choice form for corporation tax and VAT, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGFiP does not automatically issue a French VAT number after registration, complete the dedicated online 'Fiabilité et conformité' procedure or file a manual VAT registration through the SIE; any omission in books can be cured by backfilling statutory registers and a shareholder ratification decision.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: ANSM (Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament et des Produits de Santé) for French manufacturer establishment declarations; European notified body under EU Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (Medical Devices Regulation) for CE conformity assessment; DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) for environmental and classified installation compliance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: EUDAMED Manufacturer and Establishment Registration, ISO 13485 Quality Management System Certificate, CE Certificate / EU Declaration of Conformity for the colour Doppler ultrasound console, and where applicable an ANSM declaration of activity as manufacturer of medical devices in France.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) acting under the French Environmental Code and the European EIA Directive 2011/92/EU.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Simplified 'cas par cas' examination or ICPE simple déclaration; full EIA is generally not required for a low-risk medical electronics assembly site unless the facility receives specific hazardous raw materials or waste thresholds under ICPE. If below all ICPE thresholds, the facility is exempt from an environmental impact assessment procedure but must keep a compliance file for DREAL inspection.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater discharge limits apply if production uses cleaning, soldering or testing processes; assume compliance with municipal sewer approval and French Environmental Code. VOC emissions must meet European Industrial Emissions Directive 2010/75/EU BAT-AEL thresholds where relevant. RoHS 2011/65/EU and WEEE 2012/19/EU compliance is required for electronic components. Hazardous solid waste must be tracked through a registered licensed disposal chain using BSDA/BSDD tracking documents and managed by a licensed operator.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain building and fire safety clearance from the SDIS fire brigade or an approved inspector, confirming fire detection, egress, extinguishers, and specific risk zones for lithium-battery or electronic assembly operations. Arrange a structural load inspection certificate by a certified engineer where equipment or storage racks exceed floor load limits. Obtain workplace occupational health clearance through the company medical service, complete the 'Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels', and as applicable register installation use under the Labour Code through DREAL or the occupational prevention bodies.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SAS entities receive SIREN/SIRET automatically upon incorporation with INSEE; foreign entities register for VAT if turnover exceeds €35,000, appoint a fiscal representative, and obtain SIREN via guichet-entreprises.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections; hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD Directive apply

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory facturation électronique with real-time API reporting to tax authorities; digital time-stamping (horodatage) required; PEPPOL standard compliance for B2B transactions

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate on goods exported outside the EU upon proof of export; offshore services to non-EU customers qualify under specific conditions
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties up to 80% of evaded VAT plus interest; retrospective clawback of zero-rating benefits; potential criminal prosecution for fraudulent claims

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), operating within the European System of Central Banks under the European Central Bank (ECB); foreign-exchange administrative and balance-of-payments reporting competences are exercised by the Direction Générale du Trésor (DG Trésor) of the Ministry of Economy and the Banque de France Balance-of-Payments Service (Service de la Balance des Paiements).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is a fully convertible currency. France has no exchange-control authorization regime: capital movements and payments (current and capital account) are completely liberalized under Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and Articles L.151-1 et seq. of the Code Monétaire et Financier. Profit repatriation, dividend distributions, repayment of shareholder loans, and trade payments to non-residents are unrestricted, subject only to (i) domestic withholding taxes and treaty relief, and (ii) statistical declaration obligations. No prior FX license, surrender, or conversion mandate applies to inward or outward settlements. Financial institutions are obliged solely to channel transactions through licensed credit institutions and to report suspicious flows to Tracfin.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio apply to export proceeds in France; exporters may freely retain and manage euro or foreign-currency earnings. The only compliance duties are informational: (a) monthly balance-of-payments declaration to the Banque de France for transactions with non-residents cumulatively equal to or exceeding EUR 1,000,000 per calendar month or per transaction threshold; (b) Intrastat/extended Intrastat and customs ENS declarations for physical goods flows; (c) retention of export documentation (invoices, Kbis, customs SAD, ATR/CO certificates) for five years for tax and customs inspection.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (compte courant) + Capital Escrow Account (compte de dépôt / séquestre pour apport en capital)
Operational Account (compte courant) + Capital Escrow Account for formation of SAS capital
Operational Account with trade-finance and documentary-credit desk
Operational Account and cross-border SME treasury services

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium transactionally but Low as sole banking relationship. French ACPR-licensed electronic money institutions (e.g., Qonto, Shine, PayFit) provide SEPA, SWIFT-adjacent, and multicurrency accounts and are viable for day-to-day collections/disbursements. However, only a licensed credit institution (not an EMI) is eligible to act as depositary of SAS capital under Article L.227-8 of the Code de Commerce and to issue the 'certificat de dépôt des fonds' required by the notary; French banks also generally refuse foreign-resident current accounts held at UK or other offshore EMIs. Use a regulated French credit institution for statutory capital and core treasury, and reserve EMIs strictly as payment-acceptance add-ons.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For non-French-resident directors and shareholders, legacy tier-1 French banks commonly impose at least one physical KYC interview at a branch or via secured video-identification under CMF Article R.561-5-2. France permits fully remote onboarding under CMF Article L.561-7-3 (Decree No. 2022-1059) when the client authenticates with an eIDAS-qualified electronic signature or certified video-ID; in practice, BNP Paribas and Société Générale reserve this route for EEA-domiciled directors. It is therefore optimal to physically open the SAS account in Paris (or via video interview) with the managing director present, carrying original notarized and apostilled corporate documents, and to accept that certain banks require the beneficial-owner interview in French.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained injection of share capital and non-transparent beneficial-ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Kbis (registration extract), notarized statuts of the SAS, BO Registry extract (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) from INPI, audited/unaudited financial statements of the foreign parent, current passports of all ultimate beneficial owners, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements, bank statements of the subscribing entity for the past 12 months, and a signed board resolution designating the bank account and authorized signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate parent or shareholder domiciled in a jurisdiction flagged as high-risk, non-cooperative, or tax-haven (FATF, EU blacklist, or French 'état non coopératif' list)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax residency certificates from the jurisdiction, a valid Double Tax Treaty coverage memo, OECD country-by-country reporting / substance documentation, a written business-purpose and economic-substance memorandum, independent sanctions screening results, and proof that funds originate from an EU/EEA banking account rather than an offshore shell entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulated medical-device exporter false-positive: classification under ISIC 3250 / HS 9018.12 triggers health regulator and customs checks
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EU MDR 2017/745 CE-marking certificate from a notified body, ANSM registration or export certificate, ISO 13485 quality-management certificate, pro-forma invoices and product specification sheets, end-user/consignee undertakings, and customs tariff classification rationale (HS 9018.12 with no dual-use or controlled-list concern).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch or suspicion concerning the blocked-capital escrow account during SAS formation (uneven release, third-party payment for shares, nominee financing)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dépositaire certificate issued by the credit institution confirming receipt of funds, attestation de blocage (blocking attestation), list of subscribers with names and amounts, notarized minutes approving the capital increase, subscribed and paid-in capital evidence, apostilled/judicial-legalized foreign incorporation documents, and a statement that funds have not been used for money laundering or terrorist financing per Article L.225-14/L.227-8 requirements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity funding is executed via SWIFT MT103 (SWIFT MT103 or SEPA CT for EU-origin transfers) denominated in EUR from the foreign parent to the SAS's French operational or blocked capital account at a licensed credit institution. The wire must carry the purpose narrative 'Apport en capital social – SAS' and the applicable Banque de France balance-of-payments purpose code (direct-investment capital contribution); the receiving French bank will issue a 'certificat de dépôt des fonds' evidencing the payment, which the notary requires before registering the SAS with the RCS (RCS registration). Funds must remain blocked in a dedicated depositary account until legal constitution; thereafter they are free. If the aggregated monthly cross-border flow reaches EUR 1,000,000, the SAS is obliged to file the Banque de France monthly declaration via the FIDES electronic desk; there is no application for prior FX approval and no authorization threshold beyond standard reporting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for supplier payments, component imports, and service fees are executed through SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers (for standard T/T), SWIFT MT700 documentary letters of credit (for import/export LC transactions), and SEPA SCT/SCT Inst for euro payments inside the EEA. USD disbursements are settled over the CHIPS/CHATS correspondent network through French correspondents. Every payment must carry the correct Banque de France purpose code and the underlying trade dossier (commercial invoice, purchase order, packing list, transport document, and pre-shipment inspection certificate where applicable); multi-currency accounts are available to offset conversion costs. For medical-device purchases, the imported goods require CE verification and, where relevant, an ANSM import notification before clearing through French customs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla FX forwards (change à terme ferme) offered by French credit institutions for maturities up to 12 months covering USD, CNY, GBP, and JPY exposures
FX options (change à terme optionnel / vanilla call-put strategies) for contingent USD/CNY procurement or tender flows
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) on restricted or less-liquid currencies (e.g., CNH, INR, BRL, RUB) with EC-registered banks, settled in EUR or USD, available to professional clients
Cross-currency basis swaps (XCS) and plain-vanilla EUR/USD swaps under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement, subject to EMIR reporting and margin rules where not exempt

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Shareholder decision approving the statutory annual accounts and appropriation of profit or loss
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SAS corporate decision register (written consultation or general meeting; not separately lodged with a government agency)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the close of the financial year, unless a court grants an extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve the accounts exposes the president to civil liability and creditors' remedies; the annual accounts cannot be validly lodged with the registry without the approval decision.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts package (balance sheet, income statement, notes and, when applicable, statutory auditor's report) filed at the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / INPI Guichet Unique (Registre du commerce et des sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after shareholder approval and no later than 7 months after the financial year-end in the standard calendar-year case
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court registrar issues a formal notice; if the filing is not remedied, the public prosecutor may request strike-off/radiation from the RCS; a legal-entity criminal fine of up to EUR 15,000 may also apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return package (liasse fiscale forms 2065/2050 series) and supporting schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via EFI/EDI online filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year SAS: no later than 3 May of the following year; non-calendar-year SAS: no later than 3 months after the year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 10% of net corporate income tax, rising to 40% after a formal demand (80% for fraudulent concealment), plus monthly late-payment interest at 0.20%.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner declaration (déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs) accompanying RCS formalities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On incorporation and within 30 days of any change of beneficial ownership; no separate annual confirmation filing is required absent such a change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance blocks RCS formalities and is punishable by criminal fines for the legal entity; recurring omission can support strike-off/radiation proceedings.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard corporate income tax rate applicable since 1 January 2022; 26.5% for fiscal years ending 31 December 2021)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced CIT rate of 15% on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable income for qualifying SMEs (annual turnover below EUR 10,000,000 and capital held at least 75% by individuals); R&D tax credit (CIR) at 30% on eligible research expenditure up to EUR 100,000,000 and 5% above; Innovation tax credit (CII) at 20% on eligible innovation expenditure; patent box regime at 10% for net qualifying IP income; regional grants for medical technology investments available under the EU State-aid framework.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward with annual offset cap: EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000 per year

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (corporate income tax return) filed together with the statutory financial statement package (liasse fiscale forms 2052-SD to 2059-SD) and, where applicable, Form 2069-A-SD (R&D tax credit) and Form 2257-SD (Country-by-Country Report notification); all submissions made electronically through the impots.gouv.fr Pro portal using EFI or EDI-EDIFACT exchange protocols by a certified accounting firm or EDI partner
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return per fiscal year; corporate income tax instalments (acomptes) are paid quarterly on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September, and 15 December for companies whose prior-year CIT liability exceeds EUR 0.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return must be filed within 60 days of the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers the deadline is 3 May of the following year (extended to the next business day when 3 May falls on a weekend or French public holiday).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Résultat net de l'exercice: net profit or net loss for the period after ordinary tax adjustments as computed on Form 2053-SD (tax result borne from the French statutory accounts, depreciation, provisions, and nontaxable items).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident company operating through a French permanent establishment (PE), report exclusively the PE's books of account and activities attributable to France; head-office general expenses may be deducted only if directly supported and aligned with the France-PRC treaty Article 7 allocation principles.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Déficit reporté imputé: loss carryforward from prior years applied against the current-year taxable profit, subject to the EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% annual cap.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses economically attributable to the French PE may be carried forward; foreign-parent or non-French group losses are never deductible against French PE income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bénéfice imposable: taxable income after application of loss carryforwards, equal to Box AA minus Box AB, before deduction of tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute on the same legal basis as French residents; the PE must exclude all intercompany structural adjustments not supported by an arm's-length transfer pricing policy.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impôt dû: corporate income tax computed at the reduced 15% rate on the first EUR 42,500 (Box AD) and at the standard 25% rate on the remainder (Box AE).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident legal entities are ineligible for the 15% SME reduced rate; apply the 25% statutory rate to the entire French PE taxable base unless a specific exemption applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Crédit d'impôt recherche: R&D tax credit computed on eligible research expenditures conducted in France, offsettable against current and future CIT liabilities over a three-year carryforward period with possible cash refund for start-up entities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident PE may claim CIR only for R&D effectively and exclusively carried out in France by the PE's own qualified personnel; subcontracting R&D to a related Chinese entity does not qualify.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Notification identifying the ultimate parent entity in a multinational group required to file the Country-by-Country Report in its territory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The French SAS must file this notification when it belongs to a group with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000 and is itself the reporting entity or a constituent entity of a Chinese-headquartered group subject to CbCR obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing after formal demand: 10% surcharge on the CIT due; 40% surcharge for deliberate understatement or concealment; 80% surcharge for fraudulent maneuvers or abuse of law; late-payment interest accruing at 0.20% per month; fixed fine of EUR 150 for each missing compulsory return where no CIT is due; minimum EUR 1,000 fine for late filing of the liasse fiscale; criminal prosecution under article 1741 CGI with up to five years' imprisonment and EUR 250,000 fine for intentional non-filing or fraudulent filing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 30% general domestic withholding tax rate under article 119-2 of the French General Tax Code on dividends paid by a French company to non-resident corporate shareholders; 12.8% fixed income tax plus 17.2% social levies (total 30%) for non-resident individuals; 75% rate where the recipient is established in a non-cooperative jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Under the 2013 France-PRC Double Taxation Agreement, dividend withholding tax is reduced to 5% of the gross amount where the Chinese beneficial owner directly holds at least 25% of the capital of the French SAS, and to 10% otherwise. Procedure: the Chinese parent must obtain Form 5000 (French certificat de résidence fiscale, issued by the Chinese State Taxation Administration) and deliver it to the French paying company before each distribution; the French SAS must file a prior application for reduced-withholding authorization (Form 2561-SD dispense de retenue à la source) with the competent DGFiP office; a beneficial-ownership statement and, where applicable, the MLI Principal Purpose Test documentation must be retained. Where relief is not granted at source, the Chinese shareholder may file a refund claim with DGFiP by 31 December of the second calendar year following the year of payment (article R.196-1 LPF).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic rates: patent royalties paid to non-residents are generally subject to a 33.33% withholding tax under article 1678 bis CGI; other French-source royalties and license fees are subject to withholding at 25% or 30% depending on the nature of the rights and the recipient's status; interest on ordinary commercial debt is generally exempt from French withholding where the debtor is not rendering taxable services in France, but interest on participating loans and certain bonds is taxable at 30%. Treaty rates under the France-PRC DTA: interest capped at 10% of the gross amount; royalties capped at 10% of the gross amount, in both cases subject to beneficial ownership conditions and the MLI principal purpose test.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File documentation (maître-fichier and fichier pays par pays) arises under article L.13 AA LPF where the French SAS, individually or together with tax-linked enterprises, exceeds EUR 400,000,000 in annual turnover or gross balance-sheet assets; a simplified documentation duty applies to entities with annual turnover exceeding EUR 50,000,000 that have controlled intercompany transactions; Country-by-Country Report obligations apply to multinational groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000 (article 223 quinquies C CGI).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not maintain a formal economic substance regime akin to ESR in zero-tax offshore centers; equivalent substance and anti-avoidance doctrines apply with equal force: the abus de droit rule (article L.64 LPF), the acte anormal de gestion doctrine rejecting transactions lacking corporate interest, OECD DEMPE substance analysis for the transfer of IP and risk for the color Doppler ultrasound console R&D, the arm's-length principle under article 57 CGI, and the Principal Purpose Test under the MLI that France applies in covered treaties including the France-PRC DTA; a letter-box entity or marketing conduit without real French substance, employees, premises, or decision-making functions cannot benefit from treaty rate reduction or surplus repatriation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable base, such as hiding French PE sales of color Doppler ultrasound consoles, inflating deductible management fees paid to the Chinese parent, or issuing fictitious technical service invoices to shift profits offshore.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT reassessment plus 40% surcharge for deliberate misstatement, 80% surcharge for fraudulent maneuvers; late-payment interest at 0.20% monthly; criminal conviction under article 1741 CGI carrying up to five years' imprisonment and a EUR 250,000 fine (doubled for the corporate entity), asset freezing, and exclusion from public contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director of the SAS who knowingly participates in or orders the fraudulent filing can be criminally prosecuted as a co-principal; the court may impose a travel ban, prohibition from exercising corporate management (interdiction de gérer), and the director may be held personally liable for the uncovered tax and penalties through the action en responsabilité pour insuffisance d'actif under article L.651-2 of the French Commercial Code.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abusive Treaty Shopping and Shell Substance Deficiency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring the French SAS as a non-substantive conduit, or inserting an intermediate Chinese or third-country holding company with no real activity, exclusively to access the 5% France-PRC dividend rate or to avoid French-source royalty withholding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits under the MLI Principal Purpose Test; recharacterization of dividends or royalties as taxable distributions at the 30% domestic rate; abus de droit penalty of 80% of the amount understated with a EUR 12,500 minimum fine under article L.64 LPF and article 1729 CGI; criminal referral for tax fraud in aggravated cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and de facto managers who set up or maintained the artificial structure face the 80% abuse penalty being extended personally where the civil court pierces the veil upon a finding of fictitious incorporation or fraudulent use of the corporate entity; management bans and travel restrictions may be imposed as ancillary criminal penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare, maintain, or produce the Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country Report within the statutory period; failure to apply a benchmarked arm's-length margin to intercompany distribution, manufacturing, or royalty flows for the medical device export business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic fine of up to EUR 10,000 per missing or incomplete document under article L.13 AA LPF; full TP reassessment of French taxable base; 40% surcharge on the resulting assessment; exemption of the taxpayer from the adjustment if the documentation was properly prepared and timely produced remains available as a defense.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The SAS's legal representative is not automatically liable for TP penalties but becomes personally exposed through complicity in tax fraud, breach of fiduciary duty in approving non-arm's-length contracts, or where the court orders recovery from the director under the theory of faute de gestion in collective insolvency proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Money Laundering through Trade Mispricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Over-invoicing or under-invoicing component shipments for the color Doppler ultrasound console between the Chinese parent and the French SAS, or routing payments through unrelated shell bank accounts in order to repatriate hidden profits and circumvent French corporate tax and dividend withholding tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of mispriced transactions, 80% fraud penalty, and possible confiscation of the medical imaging assets; money laundering conviction under articles 324-1 and 324-4 of the French Criminal Code carries up to five years' imprisonment and EUR 375,000 fine for individuals; the corporate entity is subject to a fivefold multiplier of the fine, plus dissolution or prohibition from practicing commercial activities for up to five years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who intentionally organized or financed the laundering scheme face individual criminal liability, preventive and peremptory travel bans, seizure of personal and corporate bank accounts, prohibition from managing a French undertaking (interdiction de gérer), and the civil judge may order the director to personally repay the tax debt plus penalties under the veil-piercing rules of article L.651-2 of the Commercial Code.
